method: New text and shapes code-drawn from exact official product photographs. No photographic pixels, crop, private original or vector source distributed.

registration.note: Source native printed area crosses 3.8 mm recess and 4.0 mm outer face; both retained.

registration.target: 8Servos power socket roof with four real inspection windows

coverage: Front title/version/channel legend, fixed terminal HV/8-24V/G/G/5V colour strip and rear power/controller schematic.
limits: Raster colours, typography, line shapes and physical label sizes/positions are photo/native-recess estimates, not production-print measurements.
Continuous adhesive film is used only where the exact photograph shows the real label crossing native service openings; all original physical geometry remains intact and available with artwork:false.
Molded lettering is retained as existing geometry; no unreadable package stamps or unknown legends are invented.
No exhaustive browser pixel inspection; necessary registration, exact original physical/control/terminal-variant and Grove checks only.
rights: M5Stack product marks and original printed designs retain their respective rights; these reference reconstructions are not production source artwork.
